title: Zucchini Tots
ingredients: 1/4 cup grated reduced fat sharp cheddar cheese
1/4 tsp kosher salt and black pepper to taste
directions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray.
Grate the zucchini into a clean dish towel until you have 1 packed cup. Wring all of the excess water out of the
zucchini, there will be a lot of water. In a medium bowl, combine all of the ingredients and season with salt and
Spoon 1 tablespoon of mixture in your hands and roll into small ovals. Place on the cookie sheet and bake for 16 to
18 minutes, turning halfway through cooking until golden.
